covers: JSE session and overnight markets to about 12:05 SAST on Thursday 12 November 2026
headline: Breaking: Nvidia shares down about 6% before the US open as its board weighs Jensen Huang's future; the JSE turns higher on banks
summary: The JSE recovered from an early dip: at 12:06 SAST the All Share was at 113,957.40 (+0.4%) and the Top 40 at 105,955.83 (+0.4%), led by banks — Nedbank +2.9%, Standard Bank +2.4%, FirstRand +1.7% — and Aspen +3.1%, while gold miners stayed lower (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026). In the US, a CNBC headline at 11:49 SAST says Nvidia stock fell 6% as investors await the board's decision on CEO Jensen Huang, and MarketWatch says markets price a 50-50 chance of an announcement today (CNBC and MarketWatch headlines, 12 Nov 2026). The rand was at R16.64/$ and gold at $3,948.30 as the dollar holds near a 19-month high on Fed rate-hike bets (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 12:06 SAST; Investing.com headline, 12 Nov).

items.title: Nvidia shares fall about 6% as investors await a decision on Jensen Huang
items.summary: A CNBC headline published at 11:49 SAST says Nvidia stock fell 6% as investors await the board's decision on the CEO, after a board meeting ran into the US evening without a decision. A MarketWatch bulletin at 11:20 SAST says markets price a 50-50 chance that an announcement comes today. We could not open the articles for the exact pre-market price or any company statement. Nvidia last closed at $173.73 (+2.9%) on 11 Nov.
items.source: CNBC headline, 12 Nov 2026 11:49 SAST; MarketWatch bulletin, 12 Nov 2026 11:20 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 close

items.title: Nasdaq-100 futures slide as the Nvidia sell-off resumes
items.summary: CNBC's live-updates headline, refreshed at 11:43 SAST, still says Nasdaq-100 futures are sliding on the Nvidia sell-off. We could not open the page for futures levels. Wall Street opens at 16:30 SAST.

items.summary: A CNBC headline at 09:38 SAST says Treasury yields edged higher as investors await fresh inflation and housing data. The 10-year yield closed at 4.998% on 11 Nov. We could not open the article for this morning's levels.

items.title: JSE turns 0.4% higher by midday as banks rally; gold miners still lower
items.summary: At 12:06 SAST the All Share was at 113,957.40 (+0.4% from 113,449.53) and the Top 40 at 105,955.83 (+0.4% from 105,558.44), up from -0.3% at 10:04. Nedbank was at R302.61 (+2.9%), Standard Bank R318.09 (+2.4%), FirstRand R98.03 (+1.7%) and Aspen R177.61 (+3.1%). AngloGold Ashanti was at R1,489.48 (-3.1%), Harmony R263.76 (-1.6%) and Gold Fields R612.77 (-1.5%); Naspers was at R745.91 (-1.1%) and Prosus R676.25 (-1.1%). Woolworths was at R37.97 (+0.5%) after Wednesday's 8.5% fall.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 12:06 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 11:50 SAST

items.title: Rand softer ahead of mining production data
items.summary: Reuters and MarketForces Africa headlines say the rand weakened as the dollar gained and precious metals slid, with Stats SA's mining production figures due today. It was at R16.64/$ at 12:06 SAST, against R16.62 at 10:04 and R16.48/$ a week ago. We could not open the articles or the Stats SA release for the mining numbers.

items.title: Oil lower on peace-talk hopes and rising supply; copper about $13,741/t
items.summary: Moneyweb and Investing.com headlines say oil fell toward a two-month low on hopes for Iran and Ukraine peace talks and rising Middle East production; a separate headline says the US Energy Information Administration raised its 2026 crude price forecasts. Our price feeds give conflicting Brent readings this morning, so we leave out a level until we can confirm it. Copper was at about $13,741 a tonne.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 10:04 SAST; Moneyweb, Investing.com and MarketForces Africa headlines, 12 Nov 2026

items.title: Nvidia: shares down about 6% before the open; no board decision yet
items.summary: CNBC reports the shares fell 6% as investors wait on the board's decision on CEO Jensen Huang (headline, 11:49 SAST); we could not confirm the pre-market price. Last close $173.73 on 11 Nov. Results are due on 17 November. Leadership uncertainty is a risk to watch against our rating; no rating change from this desk.
items.source: CNBC headline, 12 Nov 2026 11:49 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026
